FN-A1ARSS-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 243
Committee: Health Sponsor: Representative Paul W. Lee
Analyst: Tiffany Weaver Date: 04/11/2023
House Bill 243 as introduced allows the Board of Medical Examiners to issue permits to a
bridge year graduate physician to practice medicine under the supervision of a licensed
physician. This bill would increase obligations of the Board by an estimated maximum of
$2,500 for the first year, and decreasing substantially thereafter, to establish a standing working
group to draft qualifications and rules for this permit. However, the increased obligations would
be offset, in whole or in part, by the collection of application and renewal permit fees, in
amounts established by board rule.
